title: Probability of a Property of Binary Values
statement: Let $L$ be a natural number and let $P$ be a decidable property of natural numbers. Interpret a Boolean string $r$ of length $L$ as the natural number $v(r)=\sum_{i=0}^{L-1}r_i2^i$. The fraction of length-$L$ Boolean strings for which $P(v(r))$ holds equals $2^{-L}$ times the number of integers $v<2^L$ for which $P(v)$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a decidable property of natural numbers
